descriptions.zh:
**请确保在使用该接口前，已充分了解 PDS 的收费方式和[价格](~~425220~~)**。

使用此功能须开通增值服务图片处理功能。

使用查询故事列表前，需要用户调用 CreateStory 或 CreateCustomizedStory 接口创建故事，否则返回空列表。
descriptions.en:
**Before using this operation, ensure you understand PDS billing and its [pricing](~~425220~~).**

To use this feature, you must enable the image processing value-added service.

Before you retrieve a list of stories, you must call the CreateStory or CreateCustomizedStory operation. Otherwise, an empty list is returned.
